# Clio

> Clio is the #1 AI-powered legal practice management platform enabling law firms to run their entire practice with integrated case management, client intake, legal research, and document automation.

Clio (operated by Themis Solutions Inc.) serves 150,000+ legal professionals across North America with cloud-based software for practice management, client relationship management, legal research and analysis, and document drafting. The platform integrates with 37+ third-party applications and supports law firms of all sizes through partnerships with academic institutions, incubators, and channel partners.

## Key Topics

- Practice Management
- Legal AI
- Case Management
- Client Intake & CRM
- Legal Document Drafting
- Legal Research & Analysis
- Cloud-Based Legal Software
- Law Firm Management
- Clio Manage
- Clio Work
- Clio Grow
- Clio Draft
- API Integration
- Legal Technology
- Intelligent Legal Work Platform

## Core Products

- [Clio Manage - Run Your Entire Practice Smoothly](https://www.clio.com/manage): Cloud-based practice management for case organization and client collaboration
- [Clio Work: AI Legal Research, Analysis, and Case Strategy](https://www.clio.com/work): Clio Work AI for legal research, document analysis, and case strategy
- [Clio Grow: Client Intake and CRM Software for Law Firms](https://www.clio.com/grow): Client intake and CRM with automated workflows and Google Local Services Ads
- [AI Legal Document Drafting Software | Clio Draft](https://www.clio.com/draft): AI document automation with templates, court forms, and e-signature integration
- [Clio App Directory](https://www.clio.com/app-directory): Directory of 37+ software integrations for Clio practice management platform
